title: 2018 AMC 12B 3
statement: A line with slope \(2\) intersects a line with slope \(6\) at the point \((40, 30).\) What is the distance between the \(x\)-intercepts of these two lines?

solutions.text:
The line of slope \(2\) is \(y-30=2(x-40);\) setting \(y=0\) gives \(x=25.\) The line of slope \(6\) is \(y-30=6(x-40);\) setting \(y=0\) gives \(x=35.\)

The distance between the intercepts is \(|35-25|=10.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Write each line in point-slope form through \((40,30)\)
Set \(y=0\) in each equation to find its \(x\)-intercept
